title: A force is a push or a pull, and a resting ball moves when one is applied
summary: OpenStax Physics says a force is a push or a pull, and that a ball moves only when it is pushed or pulled.
body: OpenStax Physics says a force pushes or pulls an object. A teaching note on the same page uses a ball: it moves only when pushed or pulled, and that push or pull is the application of a force. Applying the force changes the ball's motion. The page also says some forces act with no contact. This card is only the push-or-pull idea. It is a textbook definition, not a reading from one ball.

sources.title: OpenStax Physics, 4.1 Force
sources.author: OpenStax
sources.note: OpenStax Physics web page (/books/physics/), CC BY 4.0. Paraphrase; credit OpenStax. Supports the definition of force as a push or a pull, and the ball example in the teacher note.
